overview_description.description: Wefunder is a platform that enables startups to raise capital from their customers and community, alongside VCs and angels -- through "community rounds". Startups can raise up to $5M per year from unaccredited investors, as well as accredited investors, and can publicly promote their raise. Startups that have successfully used Wefunder to raise $5M from thousands of fans include Substack, Mercury Bank, Replit, Levels, etc. Wefunder community rounds can be stand-alone, or part of a larger (e.g. Series B) round.

product.name: Community Rounds
product.description: A platform feature allowing startups to raise funds from their community, enabling a broader set of investors to participate alongside traditional VCs.

product.name: Investment Platform
product.description: A service that connects startups with investors, allowing individuals to invest in startups and receive equity in return.

product.name: Wefunder Cash
product.description: A virtual wallet for making investments on Wefunder, facilitating transactions and holding funds in escrow.

product.name: Wefunder Gift Cards
product.description: Gift cards that can be redeemed for investments in startups on the Wefunder platform, allowing recipients to invest in early-stage companies.
